name: study 173, the gated pilot: 2,500 blind laws free of N on the eight starts in one batch, as 172 with a search seed of its own, and six gates stopping a law, a tenth let through past each: empty, too dense and disconnected as in 172, every start ending alike, the starts apart by their history, and nothing read; every other gate recording, the new cut gate among them, every law they pass to 65,536
question: The operator's question (2026-10-13): can simple local rules make a graph grow a real dimension, like space; which keep one they are given; and can the null map predict a law before it runs? Study 169 is the first study on the final probes, the installed table and the deterministic fleet (800 to 806), run on 813, its data the first clean data (the operator, 2026-11-19 21:11: "This way, we immediately have clean data from our latest codebase").

decided.why_now: 172 is the bigger baseline with only the three fact gates stopping a law; its progress bundle of 2026-11-21T15:58:19Z was read for the gates (builds 839 to 841) and the plan agreed (the operator, 2026-11-21 18:08: "I agree with all recommendations ... So go ahead, start rebuilding exactly with all your recommendations"). 172 is not touched: its last bundle is made on its own build and read as the last check before 173 starts (the operator, 2026-11-21 20:01: "I am not modifying the running study. I am only running one last study Bundle on it the moment our new study is ready to be run.")
decided.aim: the gated pilot: 172's laws again from a seed of its own, with the gates 172 only recorded now stopping a law, so that what each gate costs and saves is counted on the tenth it lets through, before a study of 100,000 laws (the operator, 2026-11-21 18:08: a small test first)
decided.gates: six gates stop a law: empty, too dense and disconnected (172's, on three sizes in a row from 1,024), and starts_alike, starts_apart_by_history and nothing_read (recorded only in 172); every other gate records its verdict and holds no law back, as in 172, the new cut gate, repeats_a_known_result and no_steady_chain among them
decided.let_through: a tenth of the laws a gate would hold back go one size on, one pick a law a size as in 172, and it stays a tenth after a gate has been right 100 times in a row: each of the six carries its own share of 0.1 in `engine.gate_shares`, so the pilot counts every gate on the same tenth at every size (decided 2026-11-21 between 19:26 and 20:02; `docs/HISTORY.md`)
decided.cut: a law with a seed that ran out of its budget in work before it settled is read by a gate of its own, `cut` (`engine.cut_gate`), at its share of 1: the verdict is recorded on the law's decision and the law goes on, so the gate is judged on every such law one size up. 172's decisions replayed under a cut gate that stops a law, a tenth let through, lose 7 of 172's 22 scoring laws at 4,096, among them its second best, 93cbf73f1bd6 at 16; the operator chose to record it only (2026-11-21 21:03, asked as a choice: "Record only")
decided.nothing_read: the gate reads a probe on a piece of 0.9 of the graph at 4,096, and of 4,096 nodes above (`engine.nothing_read_piece_share`): as built it would withhold two of 172's scoring laws whose largest piece at 4,096 is 3,993 and 4,071 nodes
decided.longer_chain: a longer chain at the size a law is at is priced against, and run on, twice that size's budget (`engine.longer_chain_budget_scale`): most of 172's laws stopped over_budget at 4,096 were a longer chain refused by under a third
decided.ledger: the gates' ledger counts the verdicts a law carried when it was stopped over_budget (`engine.ledger_counts_priced`)
decided.score: the score is 172's but for one case: a lattice start that the starts' reading calls unmoved, no edge changed, scores 1, the lowest score (score contract 6; the operator, 2026-11-21 20:02: "And yes, agree with scoring those frozen ones with 1")
decided.size: 2,500 laws in one batch, 172's ladder, starts, seeds and budgets (the operator, 2026-11-21 between 19:41 and 20:02: the budgets stay as they are); the cost is predicted in the criterion from 172's decisions replayed under this design (`tools/design_on_a_bundle.py`)
decided.drawn: the search seed drawn with Python's secrets.randbits(63) at 2026-11-21T19:43:46Z; the grid, the starts, the ladder, the budgets and the rest of the engine block are 172's
